verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no native integration that starts agent tasks from GitHub, GitLab, Linear, or Slack. It shows only a headless CLI and an embeddable runMC function that are 'safe to embed in CI scripts and servers'. Those are developer building blocks a user could wire into such platforms, not the product's own trigger integrations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can kick off agent tasks directly from GitHub, GitLab, Linear, or Slack
